bibliographic.title: "Because you are part of their memory and you are going to disappear"
bibliographic.author: lavieenmeow
bibliographic.description:
"Because you are part of their memory and you are going to disappear, the anemones are going to blossom eternally, we are not."

Leonora Carrington, The Hearing Trumpet

You could be walking down Slate Street right now, or ducking into an unlicensed plasma bar, or snorting evaporated milk with retired chatbots.

Or you could close the blinds and keep watching tv.

A few more minutes wouldn’t hurt, right?

Until the next commercial break.

Just one more episode, I promise.


This game is a 499-word tv that will distract you for as long as you want.  Made for Neo-Twiny Jam 2026.

It is a companion game to "I am inventing all this and it is about to disappear, but it does not".
